scripts.blockchain:deploy: cd Blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.start: npm run blockchain:install && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend,blockchainNode,blockchainDeploy -c magenta,cyan,green,blue "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run blockchain:node" "wait-on tcp:8545 && npm run blockchain:deploy"
